name: Table 1-23: Landmarks
_doc: Roll per Landmark within a Territory. Landmark count by body: Small=1d5, Large=1d5+2, Vast=1d5+3 per Territory. Re-roll Exceptional results if none are valid for the Planet.

rows.name: Canyon
rows.description: Vast trench carved into soil or bedrock. May reach planetary crust depth, exposing magma. Often used to assist mining.

rows.name: Cave Network
rows.description: Extensive tunnel/cave system. Cannot normally serve as navigation reference, though scanners may allow it.

rows.name: Crater
rows.description: Impact point of a meteor or orbital bombardment, or a local depression formed by tectonic forces.

rows.name: Mountain
rows.description: Solitary or range, up to ~20km in height. Ideal visual reference: grants additional +10 to Navigate (Surface) Tests.

rows.name: Volcano
rows.description: Fire-mountains or extensive volcanic vent systems. Eruptions rare but catastrophic. Extinct volcano = treat as Mountain.

rows.name: Exceptional Landmark
rows.description: Select one Exceptional Landmark valid for the Planet's conditions: Glacier (Ice Worlds / Trapped-Water+); Inland Sea (Liquid Water+); Perpetual Storm (Moderate/Heavy atmosphere); Reef (Liquid Water+); Whirlpool (Liquid Water+, normally 2+ Orbital Features).

general_bonus: Landmarks grant +10 to Navigate (Surface) Tests when visible.

glacier.requires: Climate: Ice World, or Habitability: Trapped Water+

inland_sea.requires: Habitability: Liquid Water, Limited Ecosystem, or Verdant. GM may allow frozen version on Trapped Water.

perpetual_storm.effect: Drive/Pilot Tests at -20 to pass through. May inflict 1d10+3 Energy Damage per half hour for hazardous variants.

reef.requires: Habitability: Liquid Water, Limited Ecosystem, or Verdant. GM may allow extinct reef on water-less Planets — large enough grants Mountain-like nav bonus.

whirlpool.requires: Habitability: Liquid Water+; rarely found without 2+ Orbital Features influencing tides.
